elements.requirement: With the exception of section 15 and section 16, the Fraud Act 2006 comes into force on such day as the Secretary of State may appoint by an order made by statutory instrument.
elements.quote: This Act (except this section and section 16) comes into force on such day as the Secretary of State may appoint by an order made by statutory instrument

elements.requirement: Different commencement days may be appointed by the Secretary of State for different purposes under the Fraud Act 2006.
elements.quote: different days may be appointed for different purposes

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (3), sections 1 to 9 and sections 11 to 13 of the Fraud Act 2006 extend to England and Wales and Northern Ireland only.
elements.quote: Subject to subsection (3), sections 1 to 9 and 11 to 13 extend to England and Wales and Northern Ireland only

elements.requirement: Section 8 of the Fraud Act 2006, to the extent that it relates to the Armed Forces Act 2001 (c. 19), extends to any place to which that Act extends.
elements.quote: Section 8, so far as it relates to the Armed Forces Act 2001 (c. 19), extends to any place to which that Act extends

elements.requirement: Any amendment contained in section 10 or Schedule 1 of the Fraud Act 2006, along with any related provision in section 14 or Schedule 2 or 3, extends to any place to which the provision being amended extends.
elements.quote: Any amendment in section 10 or Schedule 1, and any related provision in section 14 or Schedule 2 or 3, extends to any place to which the provision which is the subject of the amendment extends
